result.verdict: CONSISTENCY (scope-(a)), NOT an identification. The order-3 content that distinguishes chiral 5₂ from amphichiral 4₁ (which gives EXACTLY zero) yields a bar-odd tail T_odd ≈ +0.019 at the muon q0 — O(10⁻²), the same decade as the corpus bar-odd anchors S_muon (+0.00968) and S_proton (−0.03946). This structurally supports 'the order-jump 2→3 is where the Q_β bar-odd datum lives' (4₁→0, 5₂→O(10⁻²) matching the anchor scale), but cannot promote it past consistency: (i) an O(10⁻²) magnitude is generic; (ii) the sign is convention-dependent (q vs t=q⁻¹); (iii) the strip φ_odd (−0.004145) is ~5× smaller and its intrinsic value needs the open classical-exponential stripping (qbeta_g3_5two_barodd_substrate); (iv) the tail converges slowly (ratio ~0.4), so N≥4 colored Jones still adds O(10⁻³). No scope-(b) invariant is invoked. No fit; no c_k wired; only Masbaum-authoritative C_n + standard f_n.
